Set the system hostname.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Parameters

<dl class="parameter-list">

<dt>

`hostname`

</dt>
<dd>

**Required**

Hostname written to /etc/hostname.

</dd>

</dl>

## Scheduling

| Setting      | Value   |
| ------------ | ------- |
| Priority     | `90000` |
| Dependencies | None    |

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set unless `before` or
`after` constraints require otherwise. Dependencies include other recipes
without ordering them.

## Behavior

Writes the selected name into /etc/hostname in the target root filesystem.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a layer derived from a compatible base:

```toml
recipes = ["core/set-hostname"]

[parameters."core/set-hostname"]
hostname = "rugix-device"
```
